interpretation.proven: The r4 READY snapshot and the pre-r4 stopped census both report unexplained_active_runs=0 and ordinary_active_runs=24; the r4 runtime is fully ready with MCP/native alive.
interpretation.ledger_limit: The canonical ledger currently contains 28 active runs and 28 active waves; this broader count is retained as read-only evidence and is not silently collapsed to the 24-run compact census projection.
interpretation.acceptance_limit: Accepted/active status counts and metadata-key counts do not by themselves prove a particular task's operator acceptance latch; exact task/wave IDs must be checked by the supported task_control/status path before mutation.

post_canary_restart_gate_plan: Before any new patch canary, capture a fresh READY status and exact two-scope census; require unchanged activation epoch, owner identity, package parity and unexplained_active_runs=0.

After the canary, poll the original operation and capture a fresh status/census. Compare run_id/wave_id, lifecycle state, acceptance/rejection report ID and proof lineage through supported task_control reads; do not infer from ledger counts alone.

If a runtime restart or refresh is needed, create one guarded intent, verify the exact owner/start token and idle census, perform the supported restart once, then require a new READY epoch and repeat parity/identity/census gates before resuming.
If any RUN/WAVE is pending acceptance, pause policy restoration and require the operator report acknowledgement before replan; preserve the prior wave and SOL_REJECTED history.
